long_biography.plain_text:
Mark Sager entered public life soon after his teens, winning election to West Vancouver's school board and chairing it in his final year. He later served on municipal council before beginning an earlier term as mayor. Between elected roles, he clerked at the British Columbia Court of Appeal and trained as a lawyer at the University of British Columbia.

After several years at a Vancouver firm, Sager co-founded a West Vancouver practice that grew into Sager Legal Advisors and later Sager Nairne. His work centred on municipal, real-estate and land-use law. He returned as mayor in 2022 and retired from legal practice in 2024. His public responsibilities also include Metro Vancouver, regional water governance, the Municipal Finance Authority and TransLink's mayors' committee.
